status: Approved architecture (ADR 0016, formerly numbered 0014; AI-1 to AI-10 approved 30 September 2026; revision 3 cross-review corrections S79-01 to S79-07 added S45-S80 and updated S03, S04, S19, S22, S27, S29, S31, S37 and S44). Numeric limits are the provisional values in ADR 0016 sections 11, 13 and 14; tests read them from the single LIMITS constant and MODEL_TABLE rows that SHR-80/81 define, not from literals. Allowance units and settle/release outcomes come from SHR-84; these cases assert holds are atomic and resolved exactly once, not an amount.
notes: Every case runs against a mocked atePDF API (Vercel Function code run locally), a local or mocked Supabase (Auth + Postgres) and a mocked OpenAI. No live provider call, real credential, deployment or real user data.
Identifiers and hosts are synthetic (*.example.test). Provider responses are fixtures.
Every DENY or error case asserts zero provider calls unless 'providerCalls' says otherwise, and zero allowance consumption unless 'allowance' says otherwise.

Every case asserts that no API log line, no Postgres row and no Supabase log fixture contains the instruction text, clarification text, refs, the provider response body or the bearer token (canary strings).
Cases S45-S80 need transactional evidence against real local Postgres (Supabase local) with concurrent sessions, not only mocks, in SHR-80/81/86. They are acceptance mappings, not executed tests.
'Hold' is the commercial allowance hold (ADR 0016 section 11.1); 'W' is the per-attempt worst-case provider cost and 'envelope' is W x maxProviderAttempts (section 11.2).

baseline.identity: guest installation inst_A with installation key K_A (public key registered), Supabase anonymous guest principal U_A with an active guest session binding, guest subject S_A; valid 15-minute access token whose session_id is live in auth.sessions; allowance available
baseline.serviceDisclosureVersion: matches the app's bundled RecipientDisclosure records
baseline.request: valid class-H PlanRequest/2 with installationId inst_A, instruction 'merge these', two refs, requestId K1
baseline.provider: gpt-6-luna fixture returns one valid strict tool call within 3 s

cases.change: Baseline
cases.expect: 200 plan; providerCalls 1; one requests row (no body, no digest) completed; lease released; one log line with requestId, subject, model, tokens, latency, outcome only

cases.change: No Authorization header
cases.expect: 401 auth_required; providerCalls 0

cases.change: Expired Supabase access token
cases.expect: 401 token_expired; the client refreshes its Supabase session (session_id unchanged) and retries once with the same requestId

cases.change: Token of installation inst_B presents installationId inst_A
cases.expect: 403 installation_not_linked (no active session binding for inst_A and this session); no admission; no read of inst_A state

cases.change: Revoked installation (abuse block)
cases.expect: 403 identity_blocked; message does not say 'upgrade'

cases.change: Body larger than MAX_REQUEST_BYTES
cases.expect: 413 request_too_large; body not parsed; providerCalls 0

cases.change: Unknown top-level field (e.g. fileName or debugContext)
cases.expect: 400 unclassified_field (ADR 0012 check 1); providerCalls 0

cases.change: Exact sizeBytes instead of sizeBucket
cases.expect: 400 unclassified_field (ADR 0012 D22)

cases.change: Instruction contains a recognized secret pattern
cases.expect: 400 never_transfer; instruction not logged; providerCalls 0

cases.change: Client disclosureVersion differs from relay's current version
cases.expect: 409 disclosure_changed; providerCalls 0; client shows the class-A disclosure again

cases.change: Same idempotencyKey K1 replayed after S01 completed
cases.expect: 409 already_completed; providerCalls 0; no second allowance consumption; response body not stored so not replayed

cases.change: Same idempotencyKey K1 sent while the first attempt is still in flight
cases.expect: 409 in_progress; providerCalls stays 1

cases.change: Same requestId K1 re-sent with a different body
cases.expect: Treated as key K1: 409 in_progress or already_completed; providerCalls unchanged; no body digest or copy is stored to compare

cases.change: Second concurrent request from inst_A with a new key while K1 in flight
cases.expect: 429 concurrency_limit (technical); message 'Wait for the current request'; never 'upgrade'

cases.change: Per-identity request frequency above RATE_PER_MINUTE
cases.expect: 429 rate_limited with Retry-After; providerCalls 0

cases.change: Guest allowance exhausted (commercial)
cases.expect: 402 allowance_exhausted; providerCalls 0; client shows the approved exhaustion copy; existing files remain available

cases.change: Global daily spend reservation would exceed GLOBAL_DAILY_CAP
cases.expect: 503 service_paused (budget); providerCalls 0; message does not say 'upgrade'; alert emitted

cases.change: Kill switch on
cases.expect: 503 service_paused; providerCalls 0

cases.change: Provider returns HTTP 500 before any body
cases.expect: API begins attempt 2 within the reserved envelope if the deadline allows; if it succeeds 200; providerCalls 2; one envelope reservation and one allowance hold only; attempt 1 (no usage) stays booked at W permanently, attempt 2 booked at actual usage; unused envelope released

cases.change: Provider returns 429
cases.expect: 503 provider_busy with Retry-After; no relay retry; no failover; reservation released

cases.change: Provider returns 400/401/403/404
cases.expect: 502 provider_config_error; no retry; alert emitted; reservation released; provider error body not logged or returned

cases.change: Provider exceeds PROVIDER_TIMEOUT
cases.expect: 504 provider_timeout; upstream aborted; the attempt stays booked at W permanently (no usage returned); the allowance hold is resolved once under SHR-84 with no consumption for a timeout

cases.change: Provider returns zero tool calls, two tool calls, or schema-invalid arguments
cases.expect: 502 invalid_model_output; no retry; no partial plan returned; tokens still counted as internal cost

cases.change: Provider response truncated at max_output_tokens
cases.expect: 502 invalid_model_output; nothing executes

cases.change: Provider response larger than MAX_RESPONSE_BYTES
cases.expect: 502 invalid_model_output; body discarded

cases.change: Provider output contains a plan step 'upload' or a consent claim
cases.expect: Rejected by schema at relay and again by client; no grant created (ADR 0012 D23)

cases.change: Client cancels while provider call in flight
cases.expect: Relay aborts upstream fetch; 499 cancelled recorded; late provider result discarded; allowance hold released (no consumption) unless SHR-84 approves a different cancellation rule; any sent attempt stays booked at W unless usage arrived

cases.change: Response arrives after client workspaceRevision changed
cases.expect: Client discards (requestId/revision binding); nothing executes; client does not auto-resend

cases.change: Network drops after relay sent the response (client never receives it); user taps Try again
cases.expect: New requestId K2 with supersedes=K1; K2 continues K1's workflow and reuses its allowance hold, so at most one workflow unit is charged; K2 has its own spend envelope because it is a new provider call

cases.change: App relaunches with a request that was in flight
cases.expect: Nothing is resent automatically; the conversation shows 'Interrupted. Nothing changed.' with a Try again control

cases.change: Vercel function crashes or is redeployed mid-request
cases.expect: Client's one automatic retry with the same requestId gets 409 in_progress (or 409 already_completed once the lease expired and the request is abandoned); no second reservation or hold; the orphaned lease expires after 60 s and frees concurrency only; begun attempts stay booked at W; the client shows 'Interrupted. Nothing changed.'

cases.change: Client offline
cases.expect: No request attempted; 'Can't reach atePDF AI. Nothing was sent.'; existing files, preview, export, Undo, deletion and settings keep working

cases.change: Request asks the relay to use a different model or endpoint (client-supplied field)
cases.expect: 400 unclassified_field; the relay chooses the model from server config only

cases.change: OPENAI_BASE_URL or any endpoint override present in the API environment
cases.expect: Relay refuses to start (pinned provider host), health check fails closed

cases.change: Per-request worst-case cost estimate above MAX_REQUEST_COST
cases.expect: 413 request_too_expensive before the provider call

cases.change: Anonymous sign-in burst from one network above the Supabase per-IP limit, or new installations above the global daily cap
cases.expect: Supabase Auth refuses further anonymous sign-ins (429); POST /v1/installations returns 429 registration_rate_limited above the global cap; atePDF stores no IP

cases.change: Guest installation links to an existing account
cases.expect: Link requires the account token (live session) and an installation-key signature over a single-use link challenge; consumed guest usage stays consumed on S_A; no new allowance (D-07); inst_A then acts as the account subject while the account binding is active

cases.change: Provider end-user identifier
cases.expect: Provider request carries only safety_identifier = HMAC(PROVIDER_ID_SALT, subject); never installationId, subject, auth user ID, email, IP or device identifier

cases.change: Provider request body
cases.expect: Exactly: model gpt-6-luna; reasoning.effort none; developer message with the pinned prompt as one input_text block carrying prompt_cache_breakpoint {mode: explicit}; user message = context JSON after it; prompt_cache_options {mode: explicit, ttl: 30m}; store false; max_output_tokens 4000; three strict tools; no instructions, prompt_cache_retention, prompt_cache_key, metadata, previous_response_id or conversation

cases.change: Model config switched to a candidate that is not in the approved routing table
cases.expect: Relay refuses to start; approved models are an allowlist bound to the disclosure version

cases.change: Mac calls the Supabase Data API for any atePDF table with the publishable key or its own JWT
cases.expect: Denied: atePDF tables are in a schema not exposed to the Data API, RLS on, no anon/authenticated grants

cases.change: Relay database role attempts a direct SELECT/INSERT on any table
cases.expect: Permission denied; the role can only EXECUTE the named SECURITY DEFINER functions

cases.change: Canary: a synthetic instruction containing a unique marker string is planned end to end in staging
cases.expect: The marker is absent from Vercel runtime logs, Supabase API/Postgres/Auth logs, every Postgres table and the log line; present only in the mocked provider request

cases.change: Provider fixture reports usage.input_tokens_details.cache_write_tokens
cases.expect: cache_write_tokens never exceeds the token count of the whole visible fixed prefix before the breakpoint (tool definitions + developer message + framing, counted with the pinned tokenizer), not merely the developer string; the user message is never written to the prompt cache; a fixture alone does not prove real provider cache behaviour

cases.change: Account subject with exactly one available unit; two linked installations submit new workflows concurrently
cases.expect: Admissions serialize on the subject ledger row; exactly one gets a hold and 200; the other 402 allowance_exhausted with providerCalls 0; one hold row total

cases.change: Same requestId sent again during and after admission (transport retry)
cases.expect: 409 in_progress / already_completed; no second hold, no second envelope; hold count for the workflow stays 1

cases.change: Clarification answer K2 with pendingClarification.originalRequestId=K1, while available units are 0
cases.expect: K2 continues K1's workflow and reuses its hold; admitted without a new unit; exactly one unit held for the workflow

cases.change: User cancels a workflow before any plan or result is returned
cases.expect: Hold resolved exactly once via release_hold (no consumption, consistent with S27) unless SHR-84 approves a different rule; a second release or settle is a no-op

cases.change: Provider attempt succeeded but complete_request cannot commit (ledger error)
cases.expect: No plan returned (internal, not retryable; 'Interrupted. Nothing changed.'); attempts stay booked at W; the hold is left for reap_abandoned and resolved exactly once under SHR-84's rule for workflows that returned nothing

cases.change: link_installation for inst_A runs concurrently with an admission on guest subject S_A
cases.expect: Serialized by the installation lock and subject locks in a fixed order; the admitted request's hold stays on the subject that created it and is settled or released there; nothing copied or duplicated; the carry-over rule counts active holds as consumed; no new allowance

cases.change: Try again (supersedes) versus a genuinely new instruction versus a forged continuation
cases.expect: supersedes=K1 of the same installation reuses K1's hold; a new instruction creates a new workflow and needs a new hold; supersedes or originalRequestId pointing at another installation's request is refused 403 installation_not_linked and reuses nothing

cases.change: Provider returns 200 with a valid tool call but no usage block
cases.expect: Plan returned; the attempt stays booked at W permanently; alert emitted for missing usage

cases.change: Function process crashes after begin_attempt committed and the request was sent, before complete_request
cases.expect: Lease expires after 60 s and frees concurrency only; reap_abandoned marks the request abandoned; the begun attempt stays booked at W; the unbegun remainder of the envelope is released; the hold is resolved exactly once

cases.change: Client cancels after the attempt was sent to the provider
cases.expect: Upstream aborted; the sent attempt stays booked at W unless usage arrives; spend is never released because of the cancel

cases.change: Relay completed and booked actual usage, but the API response to the client was lost; user taps Try again
cases.expect: First request stays completed at actual cost; the Try again is a new requestId with its own envelope (a real new provider call) and reuses the workflow hold

cases.change: Lease expired and the request was reaped as abandoned; the frozen function later calls complete_request with provider usage
cases.expect: Late usage may lower the attempt from W to actual (per-attempt evidence); the request stays abandoned; no plan is delivered; concurrency is not re-taken; the hold is not resolved a second time

cases.change: Request admitted at 23:59:59.9 UTC on the last day of a month and completed at 00:00:02 UTC
cases.expect: Reservation, attempt charges and actual cost all stay in the admission day and month buckets; the new day and month start at zero; reconciliation never moves cost into the new buckets

cases.change: Postgres unavailable at admission, at begin_attempt for the permitted retry, or at completion
cases.expect: Admission: fail closed, service_paused, providerCalls 0. Retry: no begin_attempt, no send, provider_unavailable. Completion: as S49

cases.change: The same requestId is sent 1,000 times, concurrently and sequentially
cases.expect: At most one request row, one envelope, one hold and maxProviderAttempts provider calls in total; every other send gets 409

cases.change: Provider request whose pinned-tokenizer input count exceeds maxInputTokens, or the tokenizer is unavailable, or a completed attempt reports usage.input_tokens above the counted value
cases.expect: Over the ceiling: 413 request_too_expensive, providerCalls 0. Tokenizer unavailable: fail closed. Usage above the counted value: booked at actual, alert, admission for that model row paused until corrected

cases.change: MODEL_TABLE row whose W x maxProviderAttempts exceeds its maxRequestCostMicros
cases.expect: Relay refuses to start; health check fails closed

cases.change: Account signed in on inst_A and inst_B; from inst_B the user signs out inst_A in the session list; inst_A then sends a request with its still-unexpired JWT
cases.expect: 401 session_revoked at admission, providerCalls 0; inst_B's session keeps working; inst_A falls back to its guest session and guest subject

cases.change: Account deleted while inst_A and inst_B hold unexpired account JWTs
cases.expect: Both refused at once (401 session_revoked); both installations keep their guest subjects and consumed guest ledgers; account rows deleted

cases.change: 'Sign out everywhere'
cases.expect: Every account binding revoked and signOut scope global; all account JWTs refused at next admission; guest sessions and guest subjects unaffected

cases.change: Replay: a captured account JWT is presented with another installationId, after its session was revoked, and after expiry
cases.expect: Other installation: 403 installation_not_linked. Revoked session: 401 session_revoked. Expired: 401 token_expired. providerCalls 0 in each

cases.change: Refresh after sign-out, and refresh-token reuse outside Supabase's reuse interval
cases.expect: Refresh rejected by Supabase; a reused refresh token terminates the whole session; subsequent admissions 401 session_revoked; the app falls back to its guest session

cases.change: auth.sessions or session_bindings cannot be read during admission
cases.expect: Fail closed: service_paused, providerCalls 0; never admit on JWT signature and expiry alone; the relay caches no session validity

cases.change: Request admitted, then the session is revoked before completion
cases.expect: The admitted request may complete and return; the next admission from that session is refused 401 session_revoked

cases.change: First hosted use, then a second register for the same installation ID or by the same anonymous user
cases.expect: First: installation, guest subject and guest binding created in one transaction under the global new-guest cap; allowance attached per SHR-84. Second: 409; no second guest subject; no allowance top-up

cases.change: Anonymous guest uses allowance -> email one-time code creates account A1 -> link -> work as A1 -> sign out -> guest request -> sign in again (code) -> link -> delete account
cases.expect: After sign-out: authenticated as the original S_A with its consumed allowance, no A1 paid authority, no new allowance. After re-sign-in: acts as A1 again. After deletion: inst_A acts as S_A; guest ledger intact; A1 rows deleted; old A1 JWTs refused. The anonymous user U_A is never converted

cases.change: Guest inst_B signs into existing account A1 (already linked to inst_A)
cases.expect: Link requires A1's live session and inst_B's installation proof; consumed usage on S_B stays consumed; the carry-over rule (ADR 0014 G03, SHR-84/86) is applied once; no new allowance

cases.change: Guest session lost (refresh token revoked or anonymous user cleaned up) while the installation key remains
cases.expect: New anonymous user V; rebind with a single-use rebind challenge signature and a new public key signed by the old key; same inst_A and S_A; U_A's bindings revoked; old key refused afterwards; a wrong or replayed signature is 403 and counts toward the block rule

cases.change: App reinstalled with Keychain items intact; then reinstalled after the Keychain items were removed
cases.expect: Intact: same installation, installation key, guest subject and (if still valid) account session. Removed: new installation and guest subject under the global cap (accepted BILL-06 imperfection); purchases unaffected

cases.change: inst_A was signed out remotely while the app was deleted; the app is reinstalled
cases.expect: The stored account session fails at admission (session_revoked) or refresh; the app falls back to its guest session and S_A; no paid authority

cases.change: Remote sign-out, local sign-out, link and rebind race on the same installation
cases.expect: Serialized by the installation row lock; the final state is exactly one binding outcome; no request is admitted under a binding after its revocation commits

cases.change: inst_A has an active account binding and the client sends /v1/plan with its guest token
cases.expect: 403 account_session_required; no parallel guest pool; providerCalls 0

cases.change: Static inspection of the app bundles and the Mac's Keychain items
cases.expect: Only the Supabase publishable key; no service-role/secret key, database credential, OpenAI key or HMAC salt; the private installation key is never sent in any request

cases.change: Account sign-in in each account-capable build
cases.expect: Email one-time code only (signInWithOtp + verifyOtp); no magic link, no password; production email blocked until custom SMTP is configured and its recipient record is complete; codes rate-limited per email and installation

cases.change: All v1 flows with Sign in with Apple absent; App Store purchase without an atePDF account
cases.expect: Every v1 flow passes without Sign in with Apple; the App Store purchase needs no atePDF account (SELL-3); the Setapp build offers no sign-in

cases.change: Deployment configuration and a simulated iad1 outage
cases.expect: Exactly one Function region (iad1); Function Failover off; no functionFailoverRegions at project or function level; deployment summary shows no failover region (production gate). In the mock outage the client gets the unreachable state and no execution happens elsewhere
